recipes.title: Butter chicken
recipes.blurb: Tender chicken in a silky tomato-cream sauce

steps.text: Mix the chicken with yogurt, lemon juice, 1 tsp garam masala, paprika, half the garlic and ginger, and 1 tsp salt.
Melt 1 tbsp butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Brown the chicken in two batches, about 4 minutes each, and set aside.
Melt the remaining butter in the same pan. Cook the onion until soft and golden.
Stir in the rest of the garlic, ginger, cumin and garam masala for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, water and 0.5 tsp salt. Simmer until thick.
Return the chicken and stir in the cream. Simmer until the chicken reaches 165°F.
Taste for salt and serve with basmati rice or naan.

recipes.title: Chicken tikka masala
recipes.blurb: Charred marinated chicken in a spiced tomato sauce

steps.text: Toss the chicken with half the yogurt, 1 tbsp garam masala, turmeric, cayenne, half the garlic and 1 tsp salt.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet over high heat. Sear the chicken until charred in spots, about 3 minutes per side. Set aside.
Add 1 tbsp oil and the onion. Cook until soft.
Stir in the remaining garlic, ginger, cumin and 1 tbsp garam masala for 1 minute.
Add the tomato sauce and 1 tsp salt. Simmer until thickened.
Stir in the cream and remaining yogurt off the heat, then add the chicken.
Simmer gently until the chicken reaches 165°F. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Chicken korma
recipes.blurb: Mild, creamy cashew and yogurt curry

steps.text: Soak the cashews in the hot water, then blend into a smooth paste.
Heat ghee in a Dutch oven over medium heat. Cook the onion until golden.
Add garlic, ginger, coriander, cumin and turmeric. Stir for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and salt. Stir for 3 minutes to coat.
Stir in the cashew paste, yogurt and water. Cover and simmer until the chicken reaches 165°F.
Stir in the cream and garam masala. Simmer uncovered until silky.

recipes.title: Home-style chicken curry
recipes.blurb: Everyday bone-in chicken curry with onion and tomato

steps.text: Heat the oil in a Dutch oven over medium heat. Cook the onions until deep golden brown.
Add garlic and ginger. Stir for 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, coriander, cumin, turmeric, cayenne and salt. Cook until the tomatoes break down into a paste.
Add the chicken and stir to coat in the masala for 3 minutes.
Pour in the water, cover and simmer until the chicken reaches 175°F at the bone.
Stir in the garam masala and cilantro. Serve with rice or roti.

recipes.title: Chicken vindaloo
recipes.blurb: Tangy, fiery Goan curry with vinegar and chiles

steps.text: Mix the chicken with 2 tbsp vinegar, paprika, cayenne, cumin, turmeric, pepper, garlic, ginger and 1 tsp salt.
Heat the oil in a Dutch oven over medium heat. Cook the onions until golden brown.
Add the chicken with all its marinade. Stir for 5 minutes.
Add the remaining vinegar, sugar, 1 tsp salt and the water.
Cover and simmer until the chicken reaches 165°F and the sauce is thick.
Serve with basmati rice and a cool cucumber raita.

recipes.title: Palak chicken
recipes.blurb: Chicken simmered in a spiced spinach sauce

steps.text: Wilt the spinach in a large pot with a splash of water. Cool, then blend until smooth.
Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat. Cook the onion until golden.
Add garlic, ginger, chile, cumin, coriander, turmeric and salt. Stir for 1 minute.
Add the chicken. Cook, stirring, until no longer pink outside, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the spinach puree and water. Cover and simmer until the chicken reaches 165°F.
Stir in the cream and garam masala. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Kadai chicken
recipes.blurb: Peppers and chicken in a bold, freshly toasted spice masala

steps.text: Toast the cumin seeds and coriander in a dry pan for 1 minute until fragrant. Set aside.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Brown the chicken, about 5 minutes. Set aside.
Cook the onion in the same pan until soft. Add garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, cayenne, salt and the toasted spices. Cook until jammy.
Return the chicken, add the water and bell pepper. Cover and simmer until the chicken reaches 165°F.
Stir in garam masala and cilantro. Serve with naan.

recipes.title: Chicken jalfrezi
recipes.blurb: Quick stir-fried curry with peppers and onions

steps.text: Heat the oil in a large skillet over high heat. Sear the chicken strips until browned, about 4 minutes. Set aside.
Add the onion and peppers. Stir-fry until just crisp-tender.
Add garlic, ginger, cumin, turmeric, cayenne and salt. Stir for 1 minute.
Pour in the tomatoes and simmer until thick.
Return the chicken. Cook until it reaches 165°F, about 4 minutes.
Stir in garam masala. Serve with rice or roti.

recipes.title: Kerala coconut chicken curry
recipes.blurb: Southern curry with coconut milk and black pepper

steps.text: Heat the oil in a Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the mustard seeds until they pop, about 30 seconds.
Add the onion, garlic, ginger and chile. Cook until soft.
Stir in coriander, turmeric, black pepper, cayenne and salt for 1 minute.
Add the chicken, potato, coconut milk and water. Bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook until the chicken reaches 165°F and the potato is tender.
Serve with rice or flatbread.

recipes.title: Chana masala
recipes.blurb: Hearty chickpeas in a tangy tomato-onion gravy

steps.text: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Cook the onion until golden.
Add garlic and ginger. Stir for 1 minute.
Stir in coriander, cumin, turmeric, cayenne and salt for 30 seconds.
Add the tomatoes. Cook, stirring, until thick and the oil separates.
Add chickpeas and water. Simmer, mashing a few chickpeas to thicken.
Stir in garam masala and lemon juice. Serve with rice or naan.

recipes.title: Palak paneer
recipes.blurb: Paneer cubes in a creamy spiced spinach sauce

steps.text: Boil water, add the spinach and cook 1 minute. Drain, rinse cold, then blend smooth.
Heat 1 tbsp ghee in a skillet over medium. Brown the paneer on two sides, then set aside.
Add 1 tbsp ghee and the onion. Cook until golden.
Add garlic, ginger, chile, cumin, coriander, turmeric and salt. Stir for 1 minute.
Pour in the spinach puree and water. Simmer until thick.
Stir in the paneer, cream and garam masala. Warm through and serve.

recipes.title: Paneer butter masala
recipes.blurb: Soft paneer in a rich, mildly sweet tomato sauce

steps.text: Melt 1 tbsp butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Cook the onion until soft.
Add garlic, ginger, paprika and cumin. Stir for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, sugar, salt and water. Simmer until thick.
Blend the sauce smooth with an immersion blender, then return to low heat.
Stir in the remaining butter, cream, garam masala and the paneer.
Simmer gently until the paneer is hot. Serve with naan.

recipes.title: Aloo gobi
recipes.blurb: Dry-style potato and cauliflower with turmeric and cumin

steps.text: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add cumin seeds until they sizzle, 30 seconds.
Add the onion and cook until golden. Add garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Stir in turmeric, coriander, cayenne and salt. Add the tomatoes and cook 3 minutes.
Add the potatoes and water. Cover and cook, stirring now and then.
Add the cauliflower. Cover and cook until both are fork-tender.
Stir in garam masala and serve with roti.

recipes.title: Baingan bharta
recipes.blurb: Smoky roasted eggplant mash with onion and tomato

steps.text: Heat the oven to 450°F. Prick the eggplants, rub with 1 tbsp oil and roast on a foil-lined pan until collapsed.
Cool slightly, peel off the skins and chop the flesh coarsely.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large skillet. Add cumin seeds for 30 seconds, then the onion. Cook until golden.
Add garlic, ginger, tomatoes, turmeric, coriander, cayenne and salt. Cook until soft.
Add the eggplant and peas. Mash and stir until heated through.
Top with cilantro and serve with roti.

recipes.title: Bhindi masala
recipes.blurb: Crisp-tender okra stir-fried with onion and spices

steps.text: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wide skillet over medium-high. Cook the okra without crowding until browned and no longer slimy.
Move the okra to a plate.
Add 1 tbsp oil and the cumin seeds. Add onion and cook until golden.
Add garlic, turmeric, coriander, cayenne and salt. Stir for 1 minute.
Add the tomato and cook until soft, 3 minutes. Return the okra and toss.
Finish with lemon juice and serve with roti.

recipes.title: Aloo matar
recipes.blurb: Potatoes and peas in a gently spiced tomato gravy

steps.text: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium. Add cumin seeds for 30 seconds, then the onion. Cook until golden.
Add garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Stir in the tomatoes, turmeric, coriander, cayenne and salt. Cook until thick.
Add the potatoes and water. Cover and simmer until nearly tender.
Add the peas and cook until hot. Stir in garam masala.
Serve with rice or roti.

recipes.title: Vegetable korma
recipes.blurb: Mixed vegetables in a creamy cashew-coconut sauce

steps.text: Soak the cashews in hot water for 15 minutes, then blend into a smooth paste.
Heat the oil in a large pot over medium. Cook the onion until soft.
Add garlic, ginger, coriander, cumin, turmeric and salt. Stir for 1 minute.
Add carrots, potato, cauliflower, coconut milk and cashew paste.
Cover and simmer until the vegetables are tender.
Stir in the peas and garam masala. Cook 3 minutes. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Matar paneer
recipes.blurb: Paneer and green peas in a spiced tomato gravy

steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp ghee in a skillet over medium. Brown the paneer lightly on two sides, then set aside.
Add 1 tbsp ghee and the onion. Cook until golden.
Add garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Stir in cumin, coriander, turmeric, cayenne and salt. Add the tomatoes and cook until thick.
Add the water, peas and paneer. Simmer gently.
Stir in garam masala. Serve with naan or rice.

recipes.title: Tadka dal
recipes.blurb: Yellow lentils topped with sizzling garlic and cumin

steps.text: Combine dal, water, turmeric and tomato in a pot. Bring to a boil and skim off the foam.
Simmer partly covered until the dal is completely soft.
Whisk the dal smooth. Stir in the salt and add water if too thick.
Heat the ghee in a small pan. Add cumin seeds until they sizzle.
Add garlic, chiles and cayenne. Cook until the garlic is golden, about 1 minute.
Pour the hot tadka over the dal. Top with cilantro and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Dal makhani
recipes.blurb: Slow-simmered black lentils with butter and cream

steps.text: Soak the lentils and beans in water for at least 6 hours or overnight. Drain.
Cook them in 4 cups water until completely soft, stirring now and then.
Melt the butter in a pan. Cook the onion until golden. Add garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Add the tomato sauce, cayenne and salt. Cook until thick.
Stir this into the lentils with 2 cups water. Simmer, mashing some lentils.
Stir in cream and garam masala. Serve with naan.

recipes.title: Red lentil dal
recipes.blurb: Fast, golden dal that needs no soaking

steps.text: Bring the lentils, water, turmeric and salt to a boil. Skim off the foam.
Simmer partly covered until the lentils fall apart.
Heat the oil in a skillet. Cook the onion until browned.
Add garlic, ginger, cumin seeds and coriander. Stir for 1 minute.
Stir the onion mixture into the lentils and simmer 3 minutes.
Finish with lemon juice. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Rajma masala
recipes.blurb: Kidney beans in a thick tomato gravy, a Punjabi favorite

steps.text: Heat the oil in a pot over medium. Add cumin seeds for 30 seconds, then the onion. Cook until golden.
Add garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, coriander, cumin, paprika, cayenne and salt. Cook until thick.
Add the beans and water. Simmer, mashing some beans against the pot.
Stir in garam masala. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Sambar
recipes.blurb: South Indian lentil stew with vegetables and tamarind

steps.text: Simmer the dal with 3 cups water and the turmeric until soft, then mash.
In another pot, combine 2 cups water, tamarind, sambar powder, carrots, potato, tomato, onion and salt.
Simmer until the vegetables are tender.
Stir in the mashed dal and simmer to blend. Add water if too thick.
Heat the oil. Add mustard seeds until they pop, then curry leaves and the chile.
Pour the tadka into the sambar. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Dal palak
recipes.blurb: Lentils and spinach with garlic and cumin

steps.text: Simmer the dal with water and turmeric until soft.
Add the spinach and salt. Stir until wilted, 2 minutes.
Mash the dal roughly with a whisk or spoon.
Heat the oil in a pan. Add cumin seeds, then onion. Cook until golden.
Add garlic, coriander and cayenne. Stir for 1 minute.
Stir into the dal with lemon juice. Serve with rice or roti.

recipes.title: Chana dal
recipes.blurb: Nutty split chickpeas with ginger, tomato and spice

steps.text: Soak the chana dal in warm water for 30 minutes, then drain.
Boil the dal with 4 cups water and turmeric. Simmer partly covered until tender.
Heat the ghee. Add cumin seeds, then onion. Cook until golden.
Add garlic, ginger, tomato, coriander, cayenne and salt. Cook until soft.
Stir this into the dal and simmer. Add garam masala and serve.

recipes.title: Lobia masala
recipes.blurb: Black-eyed peas in a spiced onion-tomato gravy

steps.text: Heat the oil in a pot. Add cumin seeds and onion. Cook until golden.
Add garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Add tomato, coriander, turmeric, cayenne and salt. Cook until soft.
Add the peas and water. Simmer, mashing a few peas to thicken.
Stir in garam masala and cilantro. Serve with rice or roti.

recipes.title: Yellow moong dal
recipes.blurb: Light, soothing split mung beans with garlic tadka

steps.text: Combine dal, water, turmeric, salt and tomato in a pot. Bring to a boil and skim the foam.
Simmer partly covered until the dal is soft and creamy.
Whisk smooth. Add water if it is too thick.
Heat the ghee. Add cumin seeds, garlic, ginger and cayenne. Cook until golden.
Pour the tadka over the dal and add lemon juice. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Chicken biryani
recipes.blurb: Fragrant layered basmati rice and spiced chicken

ingredients.note: warmed with a pinch of saffron

steps.text: Mix chicken with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, garam masala, turmeric, cayenne and 1 tsp salt.
Fry the onions in 2 tbsp ghee until deep brown and crisp. Set half aside for topping.
Boil rice in plenty of salted water with the whole spices until 70% cooked, then drain.
Cook the chicken and marinade in a heavy pot 10 minutes, then spread flat.
Layer on the rice, mint, cilantro, reserved onions and saffron milk. Dot with 1 tbsp ghee.
Seal with foil and a lid. Cook over low heat until the chicken reaches 165°F.
Rest, then fluff gently. Serve with raita.

recipes.title: Vegetable biryani
recipes.blurb: Spiced vegetables layered with saffron basmati

ingredients.note: warmed with a pinch of saffron

steps.text: Fry the onions in 2 tbsp ghee until deep brown. Set half aside for topping.
Add the vegetables, yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, spices and 1 tsp salt to the pot. Cook until just tender.
Boil rice in salted water with the cardamom and cinnamon until 70% cooked, then drain.
Spread the vegetables flat in the pot. Layer on the rice, herbs, reserved onions and saffron milk.
Dot with 1 tbsp ghee. Seal with foil and a lid. Cook on low heat.
Rest, then fluff gently. Serve with raita.

recipes.title: Lamb biryani
recipes.blurb: Weekend biryani with tender spiced lamb

ingredients.note: warmed with a pinch of saffron

steps.text: Mix lamb with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, garam masala, turmeric, cayenne and 1 tsp salt.
Fry the onions in 2 tbsp ghee until deep brown. Set half aside for topping.
Cook the lamb with its marinade and the water in a heavy pot, covered, until tender.
Boil rice in salted water with cardamom, cinnamon and bay until 70% cooked, then drain.
Layer rice over the lamb. Top with herbs, reserved onions, saffron milk and 1 tbsp ghee.
Seal tightly and cook on lowest heat.
Rest, then fluff gently. Serve with raita.

recipes.title: Jeera rice
recipes.blurb: Fluffy basmati scented with toasted cumin

steps.text: Soak the rinsed rice in water for 15 minutes, then drain.
Heat the ghee in a saucepan. Add cumin seeds and bay leaf until sizzling.
Add the rice and stir gently for 1 minute.
Add the water and salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce to low.
Cook until the water is absorbed.
Rest off the heat, then fluff with a fork.

recipes.title: Matar pulao
recipes.blurb: Basmati rice with green peas and whole spices

steps.text: Soak the rinsed rice in water for 15 minutes, then drain.
Heat the ghee in a pot. Add cinnamon, cloves, cardamom and bay for 30 seconds.
Add the onion and cook until golden.
Add the rice and stir gently for 1 minute. Add peas, water and salt.
Bring to a boil, cover and cook on low until the water is absorbed.
Rest, then fluff with a fork.

recipes.title: Lemon rice
recipes.blurb: Tangy South Indian rice with peanuts and curry leaves

steps.text: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add mustard seeds until they pop.
Add peanuts and chana dal. Cook until golden.
Add curry leaves, chiles and turmeric. Stir for 20 seconds.
Add the rice and salt. Toss gently until hot.
Off the heat, stir in the lemon juice. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Moong dal khichdi
recipes.blurb: Comforting one-pot rice and lentil porridge

steps.text: Combine rice, dal, water, turmeric and salt in a pot. Bring to a boil.
Simmer partly covered, stirring now and then, until very soft and porridge-like.
Heat the ghee. Add cumin seeds, ginger, garlic and tomato. Cook until soft.
Stir the tadka into the khichdi. Add water if it is too thick.
Serve with yogurt and a pickle.

recipes.title: Tomato rice
recipes.blurb: Quick spiced tomato pulao-style rice

steps.text: Heat the oil in a pot. Add cumin seeds and onion. Cook until soft.
Add garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, coriander, cayenne, turmeric and salt. Cook until mushy.
Add the rice and water. Bring to a boil.
Cover and cook on low until the water is absorbed.
Rest, then fluff and top with cilantro.

recipes.title: Coconut rice
recipes.blurb: Creamy South Indian-style rice with mustard seeds

steps.text: Heat the oil in a pot. Add mustard seeds until they pop.
Add cashews and curry leaves. Cook until the cashews are golden, 1 minute.
Add the rice and stir gently for 1 minute.
Add coconut milk, water and salt. Bring to a boil.
Cover and cook on low until all liquid is absorbed.
Rest, then fluff with a fork.

recipes.title: Tandoori chicken
recipes.blurb: Yogurt-marinated chicken roasted until charred and juicy

ingredients.item: bone-in skin-on chicken legs and thighs
ingredients.note: skin removed, slashed to the bone

steps.text: Whisk yogurt, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, spices, oil and salt in a large bowl.
Coat the chicken well in the marinade. Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours.
Heat the oven to 450°F. Set a rack over a foil-lined sheet pan and arrange the chicken.
Roast until the chicken reaches 175°F at the thickest part.
Broil 2 to 3 minutes to char the edges.
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with lemon, onion and mint chutney.

recipes.title: Chicken tikka
recipes.blurb: Charred marinated chicken skewers, the classic starter

steps.text: Mix everything except the chicken in a bowl. Add the chicken and coat well.
Marinate in the fridge for at least 1 hour. Soak wooden skewers in water.
Heat a grill or broiler to high. Thread the chicken onto skewers.
Cook, turning, until charred and the chicken reaches 165°F.
Rest 3 minutes. Serve with lemon wedges and chutney.

recipes.title: Hariyali chicken tikka
recipes.blurb: Green herb marinade with mint, cilantro and spinach

steps.text: Blend cilantro, mint, spinach, chiles, garlic, ginger, yogurt, lemon, garam masala and salt into a green paste.
Coat the chicken in the paste. Marinate in the fridge.
Heat a grill or broiler to high. Thread chicken onto skewers.
Cook, turning, until lightly charred and 165°F inside.
Rest 3 minutes and serve with sliced onions and lemon.

recipes.title: Paneer tikka
recipes.blurb: Spiced paneer and peppers, grilled until charred

steps.text: Whisk yogurt, ginger, garlic, spices, lemon juice, oil and salt.
Fold in the paneer, pepper and onion gently. Marinate in the fridge.
Heat a grill or broiler to high. Thread onto skewers.
Cook, turning once, until charred at the edges.
Serve hot with mint chutney and lemon.

recipes.title: Seekh kebabs
recipes.blurb: Spiced ground lamb kebabs, grilled or broiled

steps.text: Mix everything except the oil in a bowl with your hands until sticky. Chill the mixture.
Wet your hands and mold about 1/3 cup of meat around each skewer into a log.
Heat a grill or broiler to high. Brush the kebabs lightly with oil.
Cook, turning, until browned and the lamb reaches 160°F.
Rest 3 minutes. Serve with chutney and onions.

recipes.title: Tandoori shrimp
recipes.blurb: Fast, bright, spiced shrimp with lemon

steps.text: Whisk yogurt, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, spices, oil and salt.
Toss in the shrimp. Marinate no longer than 30 minutes.
Heat a grill, grill pan or broiler to high. Thread shrimp onto skewers.
Cook until pink and opaque, about 2 minutes per side.
Serve right away with lemon and rice.

recipes.title: Tandoori lamb chops
recipes.blurb: Marinated lamb chops with a spiced, charred crust

steps.text: Mix yogurt, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, spices, oil and salt.
Coat the chops. Marinate in the fridge at least 2 hours.
Heat a grill or cast-iron pan to high. Wipe off excess marinade.
Cook 4 to 5 minutes per side to 145°F for medium.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Tandoori cauliflower
recipes.blurb: Roasted spiced cauliflower, crisp and charred

steps.text: Heat the oven to 450°F and line a sheet pan with parchment.
Whisk yogurt, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, spices, oil and salt.
Toss the cauliflower in the marinade until coated.
Spread on the pan in one layer. Roast, flipping halfway, until charred and tender.
Serve with mint chutney and lemon.

recipes.title: Tandoori salmon
recipes.blurb: Spiced yogurt salmon roasted in 15 minutes

steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F and line a sheet pan with foil.
Whisk yogurt, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, spices and salt.
Spread the mixture over the salmon. Marinate 15 minutes.
Place skin-side down on the pan. Roast until the fish reaches 145°F.
Broil 1 to 2 minutes for a charred top. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Naan
recipes.blurb: Soft, bubbly skillet flatbread, no tandoor needed

steps.text: Mix flour, yeast, sugar and salt. Add yogurt, warm milk and oil. Knead into a soft dough, about 5 minutes.
Cover and let the dough rise until doubled.
Divide into 8 balls. Roll each into an oval about 1/4 inch thick.
Heat a cast-iron skillet over high heat. Cook one naan until bubbled, about 1 to 2 minutes.
Flip and cook until golden spots form. Brush with butter and repeat.

recipes.title: Chapati
recipes.blurb: Everyday whole wheat flatbread puffed on the stove

steps.text: Mix flour and salt. Stir in the water and oil. Knead into a soft dough, 5 minutes.
Cover and rest the dough.
Divide into 8 balls. Roll each into a thin 6-inch round, dusting with flour.
Heat a dry skillet over medium-high. Cook one round until bubbles form, about 30 seconds.
Flip and cook until spotted. Press edges so it puffs. Brush with butter.
Stack in a towel to keep warm while you cook the rest.

recipes.title: Aloo paratha
recipes.blurb: Whole wheat flatbread stuffed with spiced potato

steps.text: Knead flour, water and 1/2 tsp salt into a soft dough. Cover and rest.
Mix the mashed potato with cumin, coriander, cayenne, garam masala, chile, cilantro and 1 tsp salt.
Divide the dough into 6 balls. Roll each into a 4-inch round and add 1/3 cup filling.
Pinch the edges closed, then gently roll flat to 6 inches.
Cook in a hot skillet until browned on one side. Flip and brush with butter.
Cook until golden on the second side. Serve with yogurt or pickle.

recipes.title: Cucumber raita
recipes.blurb: Cooling yogurt with cucumber, mint and roasted cumin

steps.text: Toast the cumin in a dry pan for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Whisk the yogurt until smooth.
Stir in cucumber, mint, cumin, salt and cayenne.
Chill until ready to serve. Dust with a little cayenne.

recipes.title: Mint-cilantro chutney
recipes.blurb: Bright green dipping chutney for kebabs and samosas

steps.text: Combine all ingredients in a blender.
Blend until smooth, adding a little more water if needed.
Taste and adjust the salt and lemon.
Chill and serve within 3 days.

recipes.title: Sweet tamarind chutney
recipes.blurb: Sweet-tangy sauce for samosas, chaat and bhajis

steps.text: Whisk everything in a small saucepan until smooth.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat.
Simmer, stirring, until syrupy and reduced by a third.
Cool completely. It thickens as it cools.
Store in the fridge for up to 2 weeks.

recipes.title: Kachumber salad
recipes.blurb: Crunchy cucumber, tomato and onion salad

steps.text: Combine cucumbers, tomatoes, onion, chile and cilantro.
Add lime juice, cumin and salt.
Toss and taste for salt.
Chill briefly. Serve with curries and kebabs.

recipes.title: Mango lassi
recipes.blurb: Thick, sweet yogurt and mango drink

steps.text: Combine mango, yogurt, milk, sugar and cardamom in a blender.
Blend until completely smooth.
Taste and add more sugar if the mango is tart.
Pour into glasses and serve cold.

recipes.title: Onion bhaji
recipes.blurb: Crisp spiced onion fritters

steps.text: Toss the onions with salt and let them sit until they release liquid.
Add chickpea flour, spices and the water. Mix to a thick batter that clings to the onions.
Heat the oil in a deep pan to 350°F.
Drop in heaped tablespoons of batter. Fry in batches until deep golden.
Drain on a rack. Serve with tamarind or mint chutney.

recipes.title: Baked vegetable samosas
recipes.blurb: Flaky pastry triangles with spiced potato and peas

steps.text: Mix flour, oil, water and 1/2 tsp salt into a firm dough. Cover and rest.
Toast cumin seeds in oil for 30 seconds. Stir in the potato, peas, spices, chile and 1 tsp salt. Cool.
Heat the oven to 400°F. Divide the dough into 8 balls and roll each into an oval. Cut each in half.
Shape each half into a cone, fill with about 2 tbsp filling, and seal the edges with water.
Place on a lined sheet pan and brush with oil.
Bake, flipping once, until golden and crisp.
